source: airbnb.co.in, captured 2026-09-15 in local Chrome via CDP at 1440x900 (desktop) and 390x844 (mobile, iPhone UA, touch). Values from getComputedStyle and getBoundingClientRect.
font: Airbnb Cereal VF, Circular, -apple-system, system-ui, Roboto, Helvetica Neue, sans-serif

type_scale.rule: letter-spacing is normal at 18px and below; negative only on headings
type_scale.search_card_lines: 15px/19px, title w500 #222222, others w400 #6C6C6C, 21px line step
type_scale.host_section_h2: 60px/64px w700 ls -1.8px desktop, 32px/36px w700 ls -0.96px mobile

surfaces: #EBEBEB hovered search segment and inactive pill
colour.brand: #FF385C core; CTA gradient linear-gradient(to right, #E61E4D 0%, #E31C5F 50%, #D70466 100%); #DA1249 active nav icon. Used only on the primary action.
colour.dark_button: #222222 pill for secondary actions (Let's talk, Learn about AirCover, Show 1,000+ places)

shadow.control: 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.02), 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.16) (row arrows); photo arrows 0 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.18)

spacing_and_layout.listing_container: 1120px content (1280px max with 80px padding); left column 653px, booking column 373px
spacing_and_layout.host_container: 1440px max with 80px padding; FAQ text column 848px
spacing_and_layout.home_rows: 7 cards at 180px, 12px gap; heading to cards about 16px; rows about 297px apart

home_row_card.heart: 32px button, 24px svg, fill rgba(0,0,0,0.5), stroke #FFF 2px, drop-shadow 0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.25), inset 8px top and right
home_row_card.badge: 104x26, radius 14, background rgba(255,255,255,0.8), backdrop-filter blur(32px), border 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.5), padding 5.5px 9.5px, inset 12px top and left

search_card.dots: 6px circles 12px from image bottom, active #FFF, inactive rgba(255,255,255,0.6), outer dots scaled 0.83 and 0.67, 5 visible
search_card.photo_arrows: 32px circles, rgba(255,255,255,0.9), 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.08) border, shown on hover

search_bar_desktop.button: 48px circle, widens to labelled Search pill when a segment is active
search_bar_desktop.focus_state: pill turns #EBEBEB, active segment white with lift shadow
search_bar_desktop.panels: open about 12px below; Where = suggestion rows with tinted icon tiles; When = Dates/Flexible toggle chips 150x36 radius 100 plus two-month calendar; Who = rows with 32px steppers and 1px dividers

search_bar_collapsed.desktop: little search pill Anywhere | Anytime | Add guests inside the 96px header after scroll
search_bar_collapsed.mobile: 342x56 Start your search pill, radius 40, border 1px #DDDDDD, sticky top 0 (68px) with tab pills sticky at top 68px

mobile_search_overlay.open_step_card: 366x532 at x 12, radius 24, padding 24, shadow 0 0 0 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.04), 0 6px 20px rgba(0,0,0,0.2)
mobile_search_overlay.footer: Clear all 88x48 text button, Search 126x48 radius 12 gradient

category_tabs.desktop: All, Homes, Experiences, Services, 14px w500, 3D animated icons, active 2px dark underline; icons drop when header compacts
category_tabs.search_filters: 34px pills radius 24, 1px #DDDDDD, 12px text, Filters button then divider

booking_card_desktop.fields: check-in and checkout 161x56 side by side, guests 322x61, grouped with 1px #8C8C8C and 12px outer radius
booking_card_desktop.handoff: fixed 80px sub-nav (Photos, Amenities, Reviews, Location) appears by scrollY 700; once the card leaves view (scrollY 3000) the sub-nav adds price line and a 179x48 Check availability

booking_bar_mobile.container: fixed, top 717, 390x127, white, 1px #DDDDDD top border, z 1999
booking_bar_mobile.text: Add dates for prices 16px/18px w700, rating 12px w500

modal_desktop.footer: Clear all text (#C1C1C1 when nothing selected) plus dark Show 1,000+ places button with live count

sheet_mobile.filters_and_amenities: 390x832 from y 12, radius 32 32 0 0, same shadow and scrim
sheet_mobile.map_results: draggable sheet over map with handle bar, floating dark Map pill when list scrolls
sheet_mobile.first_visit_notice: bottom sheet with close, illustration, 24px bold message and full-width dark Got it button

components.skeleton: no shimmer nodes found; image slots filled #DDDDDD at final size and radius while text, badges and hearts render; map paints flat grey before tiles; faint card blocks on the results page during navigation; no spinners observed

host_page.hero: H1 with personalised earnings number, 305px slider, 418x64 location pill radius 40, map card with Explore rates near you chip 178x40 radius 8
host_page.sticky_cta: Get started 144x48 radius 40 fixed in 80px header (desktop); 342x48 in an 81px bar with rgba(255,255,255,0.5) background (mobile)
host_page.sections: one 60px centred H2, three features each an icon tile plus 2 to 3 lines
host_page.faq: accordion list in 848px column, 16px w700 questions, 16px/24px muted answers
